dummmmmmy.configuration.boss_mode.health:
How much health the dummy should have when in boss mode (when given a banner)
 Default: 200
 Range: 1 ~ 1000000

Health bar color when in boss mode
Allowed Values: PINK, BLUE, RED, GREEN, YELLOW, PURPLE, WHITE
dummmmmmy.configuration.damage_numbers.c: Make critical hit damage numbers bold

How crits should be shown
Allowed Values: OFF, COLOR, COLOR_AND_MULTIPLIER
dummmmmmy.configuration.damage_numbers.d: Color to use for each damage type. Keys are damage type ids, or #tags, and are tested in insertion order
dummmmmmy.configuration.damage_numbers.e: Floating damage numbers popping off the dummy every time it's hit
dummmmmmy.configuration.damage_numbers.f: Display the numbers fullbright, so they stay readable in the dark
dummmmmmy.configuration.damage_numbers.s: Show hearths instead of damage dealt? (1 hearth = two damage)
dummmmmmy.configuration.general.DPS_mode:
Does dps message update dynamically or will it only appear after each parse?
Allowed Values: DYNAMIC, STATIC, OFF
dummmmmmy.configuration.general.disable_: Enable this to prevent your equipment from getting damaged when attacking the dummy
dummmmmmy.configuration.general.dummy_de: Makes monsters target a dummy that is wearing a player head
dummmmmmy.configuration.general.xp_per_d:
Makes dummy drop xp when hit. Training yay! Depends on damage done
 Default: 0.0
 Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0
dummmmmmy.configuration.mobs_damage_numb:
Show damage taken by regular mobs too, not just by dummies
Allowed Values: ALL_ENTITIES, ALL_PLAYERS, LOCAL_PLAYER, NONE

Show healing received by regular mobs
Allowed Values: ALL_ENTITIES, ALL_PLAYERS, LOCAL_PLAYER, NONE
dummmmmmy.configuration.scarecrow.enable: Equip a dummy with a pumpkin to make it act as a scarecrow, keeping animals away and stopping mobs from spawning around it
dummmmmmy.configuration.scarecrow.mobs_b: Animal entities that will not be scared
dummmmmmy.configuration.scarecrow.mobs_w: All animal entities will be scared. add here additional ones that are not included
dummmmmmy.configuration.visuals.animatio:
How much the dummy swings in degrees with respect to the damage dealt
 Default: 0.75
 Range: 0.0 ~ 2.0
dummmmmmy.configuration.visuals.hay_part: Show hay particles when dealing damage
Skin used by the dummy
Allowed Values: DEFAULT, ORIGINAL, ALTERNATIVE, DUNGEONS
